editorial:
Imagine waking up in a sunny Florida town and suddenly finding your whole life ruined by two students who claim you attacked them. That is exactly what happens to Sam, a guidance counselor who gets caught in a web of lies spun by Kelly and Suzie. From the start, you can tell that nobody in this movie is actually a good person. It feels like a high-stakes game of poker where everyone is bluffing, and the atmosphere is thick with greed and secret plans. You will spend most of your time trying to figure out who is playing whom while the plot takes turns you never saw coming.

The best part is how the movie keeps flipping the script on you. The acting is great, especially the chemistry between the leads, and the pacing keeps you on your toes. While some of the plots are a bit wild, it is just a fun ride. If you want to experience this with the best picture and sound, you should definitely look for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection. If you prefer streaming, renting it on Apple TV is a quick way to jump in. It is a perfect pick for a movie night when you want something twisty.
endingExplained: You find out that almost every character was lying to get money. Kelly and Suzie were actually working together to frame Sam and then double-cross each other. In the final twist, it is revealed that the two girls were actually in a relationship the whole time. They managed to trick everyone and walk away with the money, leaving the adults defeated. It ends with them laughing about how they played the system.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves movies where you can't trust any of the characters.
